craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta-adbhuta of closing praise — vismaya that proof flees the fated yet Self shines within all. Closing flash: Self-in-every-breather; Recognition-apart (forward glance per UNC); midnight-fire (rhyme L3s, quatrain kept). Rejected: (a) trimming quatrain → killed: four lines, four turns. (b) joining made-here → killed: elsewhere per UNC. Read aloud: YOUR-own-SELF FLASH-es … MID-night-FIRE BURNS-bright-ER IN-our-HANDS.

lines: Your own Self flashes — Īśvara, in every breather's heart,
Maker and Knower — yet Recognition stands apart;
we wrought its joining elsewhere; in duality too it stands —
fit, and fuller: midnight fire burns brighter in our hands.

reads_against.argmap: Who shines within — and who signs? → Self is Īśvara within all; the proof stands even dualist; signature and forward glance.
c1_essence: Proof needs fitness: thousand-proved, it fails the deluded; the palm-held Jewel flees the fate-struck (v55). Self flashes as Īśvara within all breathers, maker and knower; recognition to be effected, joining made elsewhere; the proof stands even in duality — midnight fire (v56).
